name: samsung device update list
description: Samsung devices listed for regular security updates, with their update cadence (monthly, quarterly, biannual).

fields.name: model
fields.description: Device model as Samsung lists it, e.g. Galaxy S25 Ultra.

fields.name: series
fields.description: Series heading the model is listed under, e.g. Galaxy S Series.

fields.name: cadence
fields.description: Update cadence named in the group heading (Monthly, Quarterly, Biannual); empty when the heading names none.

fields.name: group
fields.description: The heading of the list, e.g. Current Models for Monthly Security Updates.
